svg.title: LIO-SAM pipeline (schematic)
svg.desc: IMU preintegration de-skews scans and gives an initial guess; edge and planar features feed LiDAR odometry against sub-keyframes; keyframe states are joined by IMU, odometry and loop-closure factors in an iSAM2 factor graph whose optimised poses build the global map. GPS is supported by the algorithm but not used here.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
